1: The name God gave himself to Abraham, El Shaddai, usually translated 'God Almighty'.
2: To turn or turn back; the prophets' main word for repentance and God's call to come home.
Merciful and compassionate, the first quality God names when he describes himself to Moses.
To comfort, or to change course out of compassion: 'Comfort, comfort my people'.
Literally 'long of nostrils': slow to grow hot with anger.
One word for spirit, wind and breath; Genesis 1:2 and Ezekiel's valley of dry bones play on all three.
3: To judge: to govern and set things right; the judges were rescuers as well as rulers.
